reading.title: The Discovery of Exoplanets and Stellar Systems
reading.passage: Astronomers have revolutionized our understanding of planetary systems through the discovery of exoplanets orbiting distant stars. Since 1995, over 5,000 exoplanets have been identified, revealing that planetary formation is far more common than previously believed. These discoveries employ sophisticated techniques such as the transit method, which detects subtle brightness fluctuations as planets pass in front of their host stars. This technological advancement suggests that life-supporting worlds may exist throughout the universe, fundamentally challenging our perspective on Earth's uniqueness.

questions.q: According to the passage, which method is used to detect exoplanets?
options: A) Direct telescopic observation of planetary surfaces
B) Measuring gravitational effects on nearby stars
C) Detecting brightness changes as planets cross in front of stars
D) Analyzing radio signals from distant solar systems
questions.explanation: 지문에서 'the transit method, which detects subtle brightness fluctuations as planets pass in front of their host stars'라고 명시되어 있습니다.

questions.q: What can be inferred from the passage about planetary systems in the universe?
options: A) Most stars do not have planetary systems
B) Planetary formation appears to be a widespread phenomenon
C) Only Earth-like planets have been discovered
D) Exoplanet discovery ended in 2010
questions.explanation: 지문에서 '5,000 exoplanets have been identified, revealing that planetary formation is far more common than previously believed'라고 했으므로, 행성 형성이 광범위하게 일어나는 현상임을 추론할 수 있습니다.

writing.prompt: Do you agree or disagree with the following statement? Immigration policies should prioritize skilled workers and professionals over refugees and family reunification. Use specific reasons and examples to support your answer.

structure.intro: 도입부 작성 가이드: 프롬프트를 다시 표현한 후, 이민 정책의 목표(경제 발전 vs 인도주의)에 대한 자신의 입장을 명확히 제시하세요. 예시: 'While skilled immigration has economic benefits, a balanced approach considering humanitarian concerns is more important.'
structure.body1: 본론 1 아이디어: 숙련된 근로자 우선정책의 경제적 이점 논의. 구체적 예시로 캐나다의 포인트 기반 시스템이나 싱가포르의 선별적 정책 언급. 그러나 장기적 사회 안정성 측면에서의 한계도 제시하기.
structure.body2: 본론 2 아이디어: 난민과 가족 재결합의 인도주의적 및 사회적 가치 강조. 예시: 난민 수용이 문화 다양성을 증진하고, 가족 재결합이 이민자들의 정착 성공률을 높임. 또한 역사적 관점(미국의 다양한 이민 배경)에서의 성공 사례 제시.
structure.conclusion: 결론 작성 가이드: 자신의 입장을 재확인하면서, 이상적인 이민 정책은 경제 발전과 인도주의적 책임의 균형을 맞춰야 함을 강조하세요. 'The most effective immigration policy must balance economic needs with humanitarian values.'

speaking.prompt: Some people prefer shopping online for convenience and variety. Others prefer shopping in physical stores for the experience and immediate gratification. Which do you prefer and why? Include specific reasons and details.
sample_points: 온라인 쇼핑의 편의성: 24/7 접근 가능, 다양한 제품 비교, 배송 서비스
매장 쇼핑의 장점: 제품을 직접 확인 가능, 즉시 구매 가능, 대면 고객 서비스, 사회적 경험
결론: 개인의 라이프스타일과 상황에 따라 두 방식을 혼합하여 사용하는 것이 최적

listening.title: 기숙사 배정 및 숙박 옵션 상담
listening.script:
Student A: Hi, I'm trying to figure out my housing situation for next semester. Do you know how the dormitory assignment process works?

Staff: Of course! We assign dorms based on several factors including class year, major, and housing preferences. Freshmen are typically placed in the main residence hall. 

Student A: That sounds good. Are there other options available?

Staff: Yes, we have several choices. There's the main dorm I mentioned, plus upper-class housing, themed housing communities, and off-campus apartments for seniors. We also offer a lottery system for popular residences.

Student A: What about accommodations? I have a mobility issue and need an accessible room.

Staff: Absolutely. Our accessibility office works directly with our housing department. Just submit a request with documentation, and we prioritize accessible rooms accordingly. We have elevators, accessible bathrooms, and parking near dormitories.

Student A: That's reassuring. When should I submit my preferences?

Staff: Preferences are due by April 15th. I recommend submitting early. Housing fills quickly, especially for specific accommodations. You'll receive your assignment by May 30th.

questions.q: What is the main topic of the conversation?
options: A) The cost of campus housing
B) The dormitory assignment process and housing options
C) How to apply to the university
D) Meal plan options in the dining hall
questions.explanation: 직원이 기숙사 배정 과정, 주택 옵션(메인 숙소, 상급생 주택, 테마 주택, 캠퍼스 외 아파트)에 대해 설명하고 있습니다.

questions.q: What does the staff member suggest regarding the housing preference deadline?
options: A) Students can submit preferences anytime during the semester
B) The deadline is not important
C) Submitting early is recommended because housing fills quickly
D) Only seniors need to submit preferences by the deadline
questions.explanation: 직원은 '4월 15일까지 제출해야 하며, 특히 특정 숙박시설을 원할 경우 서둘러 제출할 것을 권장합니다.'라고 명시했습니다.

questions.q: Why does the staff member mention the accessibility office?
options: A) To explain the general location of campus offices
B) To address the student's mobility accommodation needs and ensure proper housing support
C) To encourage all students to request accessible rooms
D) To discuss the staff member's personal housing experience
questions.explanation: 학생이 이동성 문제로 인한 접근 가능한 객실이 필요하다고 언급했을 때, 직원은 접근성 사무실이 주택부서와 직접 협력하여 서류를 제출하면 접근 가능한 객실의 우선순위를 정한다고 설명합니다.
